The map's own bootstrap draws 3000 resamples per row set, which does not determine a second decimal: over $200$ seeds the Monte-Carlo spread of an endpoint any seed moves runs $0.0009$ to $0.223$, and 42 of the 46 endpoints drawn at that count stand inside four Monte-Carlo standard errors of the rounding boundary their second decimal turns on---the closest reaching 0.8 and the median 0.1 of the four required. The interval column of Tables~\ref{tab:map-full} to~\ref{tab:map-xtab} is therefore not that output: every row set was re-drawn at a count chosen from its own Monte-Carlo error---$1.8\times10^{5}$ to $1.2\times10^{8}$ draws---and prints at the precision that count supports, cell by cell. Note~\emph{b} of Table~\ref{tab:map-full} gives the rule and the count at each precision.
